sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.6
sources.evidence: February 5, 2026 announcement names Claude Opus 4.6 and API ID claude-opus-4-6; introduces adaptive thinking and 1M-token context, and describes coding, agentic and knowledge-work capabilities.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.6 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists February 5, 2026 release, 1M-token context, adaptive thinking, text/image input and text output, and claude-opus-4-6 ID.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: Methods describes Transformer residual-stream layers and Jacobian-lens analysis. The paper explicitly includes Opus 4.6 ablation experiments in the experiential-report subsection (#ws-experience) and alignment examples in section 5.3; section 5.4 calls the preceding cases production models. Pre-release audit origin is distinguished from artificially trained model organisms.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: States generally that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. Used only for weight-distribution status, not architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial API service terms reserve intellectual-property rights except the rights expressly granted; supports proprietary service classification alongside the explicit nonpublic-weight policy.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing; the page specifically discusses Opus 4.6 and earlier on Bedrock and explains PDF text/image processing.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Defines function calling and explicitly lists Claude Opus 4.6 tool-choice modes and tool-use system-prompt overhead.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded successfully from official redirect to assets.claude.com/6a5fa276ac68b9aeb0c8b6af5fa36326e0e166dd.pdf after browser size-limit failure. Section 1.1 describes training and adaptive reasoning; reviewed text contains no production total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party system card downloaded from official redirect to assets.claude.com/fc1b44717c85dc068bc6ba5024219938094694bd.pdf. Reviewed its Opus 4.6 comparisons and parameter references; no total or active production count for Opus 4.6 found.

sources.title: Models overview
sources.evidence: Explicitly states that Claude Opus 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.6 report the opus model line in the Models API.

name.note: Exact official display name and matching API identifier.

developer.note: First-party announcement and system card identify Anthropic.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the explicitly documented Claude opus model line.

release_date.note: Official announcement and exact model page both give February 5, 2026.

open_weights.note: Explicit general Claude nonpublic-weight policy applies to this Claude model; hosted access is separately documented.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification for a nonpublic-weight model offered under commercial service terms; not an asserted open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count disclosed in reviewed exact-model card or later Opus 5.5 comparison material. Targeted first-party parameter searches also found no count; no estimate substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token production count disclosed in reviewed cards. Sparse interpretability features and experimental ablation dimensions are not model parameters.

architecture.note: Exact Opus 4.6 experiments use the Transformer residual-stream/Jacobian-lens framework. Section 5.3 is from pre-release audits, while section 5.4 explicitly calls those production models; the separate experiential-report subsection also names Opus 4.6 experiments. Supports transformer only, not dense/MoE subtype or layer count (displayed layer indices are normalized).

context_window.note: Exact current model page gives 1M tokens; announcement originally described this as beta.

modalities.note: Exact model page verifies text/image input and text output; PDF is retained as the catalog-supported document input format, processed as text plus images.

reasoning.note: Adaptive reasoning explicitly documented for exact model.

tool_call.note: Exact Opus 4.6 row lists supported tool-choice modes in official function-calling documentation.

description.value: Claude Opus model for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, with adaptive reasoning and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Replaces unsupported comparative latency wording with documented use cases and features.

GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by exact-model interpretability experiments; dense/MoE subtype and total/active production parameter counts are undisclosed in reviewed primary sources. PDF input denotes document processing through text and vision.

summary: Verified all 14 fields against first-party sources. Adds transformer architecture and proprietary classification; replaces unsupported slower-expert-reasoning wording. Confirms February 5, 2026 release, 1M context, text/image/PDF input, text output, reasoning and tools. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed after exact-model and later-card checks.
